info.title: airouter API
info.description:
airouter routes your prompt across many free-tier AI providers (Groq, Gemini, Gemma,
OpenRouter, Z.AI, Mistral, SambaNova, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible URL) and
automatically fails over when one hits a limit.

**Authentication**
- Tenant endpoints: `Authorization: Bearer air_...` (or header `X-API-Key: air_...`).
- Admin endpoints: `Authorization: Bearer <AIROUTER_ADMIN_TOKEN>`.
- The admin token also works on tenant endpoints; add `X-Tenant-ID: acme` (or `?tenant=acme`) to act as that tenant.

**Two API styles on one server**
- *Native* (`/v1/generate`, `/v1/speak`, `/v1/transcribe`) returns richer data (attempts, latency).
- *OpenAI-compatible* (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`, `/v1/audio/*`) works with any OpenAI SDK.

post.summary: Generate text (or JSON) with automatic failover
post.description:
Send either `prompt` **or** `messages`. The router tries providers by priority and fails over on
429 / 5xx / bad key. Add `?format=text` (or `Accept: text/plain`) to get only the text.
Response headers: `X-AIRouter-Provider`, `X-AIRouter-Model`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `text` returns plain text instead of JSON

example.text: Rain taps softly on the window.

post.description:
Returns raw audio bytes by default (`Content-Type: audio/wav`).
Add `?format=json` (or `Accept: application/json`) to get a JSON envelope with base64 audio.
Headers on raw audio: `X-AIRouter-Provider`, `X-AIRouter-Model`, `X-AIRouter-Voice`.

Note: the query `?format=json` controls the *response envelope*; the body field `format` controls the *audio format* (wav/mp3/pcm).


**Voices:** with ElevenLabs you can pick a voice per request by id or by name, tune it with `voice_settings`, and use voices you cloned (see *Voices*). A wrong voice answers `404 voice_not_found` and never pauses the provider.
Multipart upload (max 32 MB). Add `?format=text` for plain text output.

post.summary: Clone a voice from recordings (ElevenLabs Instant Voice Cloning)
post.description: Upload 1 to 25 clean recordings (max 12 MB each, 50 MB total). **You must confirm you have the speaker's permission** (`consent=true`). A tenant clones inside its **own** ElevenLabs account (add one with `me add -preset elevenlabs`); cloning in the shared account needs the operator to enable it. Max 10 clones per tenant by default. Instant cloning needs an ElevenLabs plan that includes it.

consent.description: Must be true: you have the speaker's permission or the rights

files.description: Repeat the field for each recording

provider.description: Pin one ElevenLabs provider by name

403.description: No ElevenLabs key of your own, and cloning on the shared account is not enabled

post.description:
Turns text into vectors with failover across embedding providers (category `embed`).

**For vector search read this:** vectors from different models, or of different sizes, cannot be compared. Failover can switch models. Pin one model with `model` (a provider name or exact model id), and set `dimensions` so a provider that answers with another size is skipped. Store `model` and `airouter.dimensions` with your index. `gemini-embedding-001` returns **3072** numbers by default.

Up to 2000 texts per call (sent upstream in batches of 100 to the same provider). Empty texts are rejected. `encoding_format` must be `float`.

model.description: `auto` (router chooses and fails over), or a provider name / exact model id to pin one

input.description: A string or a list of strings

dimensions.description: Exact vector size wanted. Sent upstream and enforced: other sizes are rejected and the next provider is tried

post.summary: Share an operator voice with every tenant (admin)
post.description: By default a cloned voice is private. The operator can share a voice **it cloned** (as the default tenant) so every tenant that can use that ElevenLabs provider can list and speak with it. Tenants' own clones can never be shared. Usage is billed to the ElevenLabs account the voice lives in. Send `{"shared":false}` to make it private again (effective at once).

bearerAuth.description: Tenant API key (`air_...`). `X-API-Key` header is also accepted.

MaxWait.name: max_wait
MaxWait.description: How long to wait for a briefly rate-limited provider before failing over, e.g. `5s` or `5` (seconds). Max 2 minutes. Default: the server's setting (20s).

BadRequest.description: Request is invalid. Fix it; do not retry as-is.

Forbidden.description: Tenant disabled, or admin API disabled (no AIROUTER_ADMIN_TOKEN set)

NotFound.description: Not found (also returned when the id belongs to someone else)

TenantLimit.description: Your tenant's daily request cap is used up

example.error: airouter: tenant daily request limit reached

UpstreamFailed.description: Providers were tried and all failed; see `attempts`

example.error: airouter: all providers failed: groq: HTTP 500

ProvidersBusy.description: Every provider is limited or cooling down. Retry after `Retry-After`.

example.error: airouter: all providers are limited right now (retry in 34s)

VoiceNotFound.description: No such voice for this tenant (also for another tenant's voice)

Attempt.description: A provider that was tried and failed before the successful one. `status` and `kind` are filled for text, speech, transcription and embeddings.

GenerateRequest.description: Send `prompt` or `messages` (one of them is required).

json.description: Ask for a JSON answer and validate it; fails over if the model returns junk

provider.description: Pin one provider by name (see provider list)

strategy.description: priority (default) tries lowest priority number first; spread balances load

json.description: Parsed JSON (only when request had json:true)

attempts.description: Providers that failed before this one

own.description: true when the tenant's OWN key answered (free under a pool-only cap)

voice.description: Voice id OR voice name. Defaults: `Kore` (Gemini), `tara` (Groq Orpheus English), `hassan` (Orpheus Arabic). **ElevenLabs:** a voice id or a name (case-insensitive) of a voice you can use, including your own clones; empty = the first ready-made voice.

format.description: **Audio** format. `mp3`/`opus` are made natively by ElevenLabs; for Groq and Gemini airouter converts the WAV with ffmpeg (if ffmpeg is missing you get WAV back and `format` says so). `opus` is mono Ogg/Opus: what WhatsApp and Telegram voice notes need.

model.description: ElevenLabs only: model for this request (default: the provider's model)

own.description: true when the tenant's OWN key answered (free under a pool-only cap)
true when the tenant's OWN key answered (free under a pool-only cap)

content.description: A string, or an array of `{type:"text", text:"..."}` parts

usage.description: Only `total_tokens` is filled in; prompt/completion are 0

pool_only_cap.description: When true the daily cap counts only answers from the shared pool. Requests served by the tenant's own keys are free and still work after the cap is reached.

Preset.description: Connection defaults for a provider preset (field names are Go-style, e.g. Kind, BaseURL)

ProviderInput.description: Use `preset` to fill defaults from the catalog, then override anything.

preset.description: groq, gemini, gemma, gemini-tts, elevenlabs, openrouter, mistral, zai, sambanova, huggingface, ollama, ollama-remote, openai

api_key_env.description: Env var holding the key (admin only; tenants cannot use it)

model.description: Exact model id from the provider console

category.description: Which request shape the model expects. `embed` = embeddings (`/v1/embeddings`).

rpm.description: Requests per minute, 0 = no local cap

reset_tz.description: Timezone where the daily quota resets (default UTC)

json_mode.description: false if the model rejects response_format (e.g. Gemma)

system_role.description: false if the model rejects system messages (e.g. Gemma)

used_today_hint.description: Requests already used today (only when adding)

tenant_id.description: Admin only. Restrict to one tenant; empty means shared

resets_in_seconds.description: Seconds until this model's quota resets

similarity_boost.description: Higher = closer to the original voice
